name: Suspension Pike
steps: Place both feet into the low cradles of a suspension trainer and press into a high plank with hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Keep your legs locked straight and brace your core firmly in a flat horizontal line.
Contract your abs powerfully to lift your hips straight up toward the ceiling while pulling your straight legs toward your hands.
Pause briefly in the inverted V peak, then lower your hips slowly back to the flat plank.
tips: Keep your knees straight and draw your hips vertically up rather than bending your knees into a tuck.
Stop at a flat plank on the return instead of letting your lower back sag toward the floor.
